description: Semantic mutation candidates for input-shaping settings through the public Print/export path.

mutants.description: Marlin 2 Disable is the single zero-valued command with no axis token and must not append a Y command; the Disable row checks this directly.
RRF uses the X frequency as its shared F value; the RRF row supplies distinct X/Y values and rejects the Y value.
A zero endpoint suppresses the Marlin F token while retaining the axis command; the two endpoint rows reject an unsolicited F0.00 token.
Marlin 2 must preserve the independent Y damping value; the representative row supplies distinct X/Y damping and checks the Y token.
Documented modern RRF shaper names must reach their own P token; the six-value subset checks exact token routing while the other registry choices remain partial characterization.
